gist.summary: Added @rekty’s PollinationsCraft to the games catalog and recent-apps list. The Paper plugin lets Minecraft server players talk to villager NPCs with personas by right-clicking or using /polli say; the server owner pays with their own Pollen.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art Minecraft-style village garden, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and watches a player chat with a blocky villager beside lime green (#ecf874) flowers. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, with warm cream and pastel gradients, dark purple (#110518) outlines, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
